CLUSTER-READ-ELEC MERGE PLAN (7→1): Target = blog/01-how-to-read-your-electric-bill.md. Proposed section outline: (1) Quick Answer [from 01 + complete-guide workflow]; (2) Find These Items First [from 01 + how-to-read-your-utility-bill generic tips as callout]; (3) What a kWh Means [from 01]; (4) Read Meter Information Carefully [from 01 + pull in how-to-read-electric-meter context]; (5) Understand the Charges on Your Statement [NEW: merged from electric-bill-breakdown charge taxonomy — Supply, Delivery, Fixed Charges, Taxes/Surcharges, TOU/Tiered, Demand — with sub-tables per fee type]; (6) Calculate a Bill-Wide Effective Rate [from 01]; (7) Check for Tiers or Time-of-Use Pricing [from 01 + 08 time-of-use details]; (8) Review a Higher-Than-Expected Bill [from 01 + merged from why-electric-bill-changes-month-to-month and how-utility-rates-fees-usage-work-together angle]; (9) What to Do if You Think the Bill Is Wrong [from 01]; (10) Frequently Asked Questions [from 01 + electric-bill-breakdown]; (11) Sources [consolidated unique sources from 01 + electric-bill-breakdown: ~9 unique]. Systematically thin categories: Bills & Fees (most fee explainers <400w with 1-2 sources), Gas (many zero-source long pages), Water (several seasonal pages with 0 sources).
